title: Dynamic Label Injection for Imbalanced Industrial Defect Segmentation
mechanism: During training, inject real defects into defect-free images by Poisson seamless cloning and cut-paste so every batch is class-balanced, replacing loss-side balancing.
adaptation: Target inactive (42 train cells), splice (never predicted), edge_dark, corrosion, not crack: clone inactive regions with their bounding crack into clean cells of the same source and mono/multi type so the inactive-touches-crack rule holds.
evidence: R: Magnetic Tile multi-class, IoU gain over balancing losses, also under weak supervision (numbers not read). Code per web search at github.com/covisionlab/dynamic-label-injection (unverified).
min_experiment: Arm: house + per-batch Poisson-cloned inactive(+crack), splice, edge_dark; baseline: house; metric: CV inactive IoU (test is decided by 3 cells) and splice IoU; kill if CV inactive IoU gain < +0.02 and splice stays 0.
prior_overlap: Crack copy-paste onto pool cells was n.d. (more decoys); inactive / rare-class injection with Poisson blending and batch balancing not tested.
